method: Transparent native APFS compression of raftlog files in six stopped verified cohorts. Exclusive single-link files only; exact SHA-256, size, mode, uid, gid and mtime checked before/after replacement. Original duplicate released only after both copies verify. Original named-volume options and image/volume inventories remain unchanged; read-only Docker probes through each volume match host hashes. No logical evidence, image or volume is pruned.
